author: ALM
body:
Hello TeamSpeak Developers!

I was banned today for 7 days with the reason "Leaking personal information of another user."

This infraction is invalid and below I shall explain why:

It was a warm sunny day, I was hanging out on teamspeak with some friends and having a good time. Liz (Midnightstorm) was filling out legal forms and got to the part where she was supposed to enter her phone number. People in the channel were like "say it out loud! say it!" and I was like "Want me to?"

I then proceeded to read out a fake number, that was similar to the number of another user, Lindstagram. The thing is, the number I read was at least two digits off from the actual number.

The person who banned me, Zac, even called the number and discovered that it was a completely different person.

The last time I checked, reading out random numbers does not equate to leaking personal information of users.

Thanks,
ALM

replies.author: Newcleus
replies.body:
Howdy there ALM!
It's Zac here. Anyways you read out the number correctly. As you and the other users in the channel can recall you read out a phone number (it was a user's) claiming it was user's after this I hastily wrote down the number, which you had read out trying to remember it. I then called this number only to realize the user on the other end was not the user. You then asked me to read the number back to you and when I did so you remarked that the number I read back was 2 numbers off (Note that it was the number I read back to you that was two numbers off, and that if the number you had given me was two numbers off to begin with you would not have had me read it back to you for confirmation). We have a reliable witness who can confirm this along with the fact that I was also there to witness these events.
We do not appreciate lying in these appeals and due to the fact that you have done so I will now deny this appeal.
Regards,
Zac.

replies.author: ALM
replies.body:
I would like to dispute the denial and ESCALATE the appeal. I would like strong evidence of this happening since all you are relying your claims on is witness testimony.

Also:


O and a revision of your previous post mentions Midnightstorm - She mentioned to me two days ago that she actually "didn't remember" what happened. I do question the validity of your witnesses and have yet to see any evidence as to the incident. As Zac has stated, "I wrote down the number hastily and missed some digits." If he at that time wrote down an incorrect number, it is not possible for him to now `remember` what the actual number is. Also, the quote that you were two number off originally came from Liz, who actually has her number.

I would also like to point out that at the time of the incident, there was a discussion if this could be considered as info leaking and it was come to by a majority of people in the channel that the actual number was not leaked, and therefore no information was leaked. The person who banned me even laughed it off and we continued to talk for almost 20 minutes without banning me or even mentioning the incident. 

I feel that after I left, users were coerced into saying that they heard a real number and I was banned LONG after I left. I have reports from users saying that Michael, Chris. Steven, and Zac were all seen in a channel laughing and when a user joined the words "I hope he retires" were heard. Also, multiple users reported that they were talked to by Zac to expect something "funny" wishing the next two hours. This seems like a huge coincidence as it was the same time as the ban was issues. Even if this is untrue, it seems highly unlikely that the people in the channel (minus the ones who back up my claim) when the incident happened were seen a short time later laughing about the incident.

replies.body:
Sorry, I hadn't been able to respond due to IRL stuff.

Howdy there, 
You cannot dispute the appeal denial or escalate it as TeamSpeak Devs are the highest authority on TeamSpeak rules. Despite this I will answer your most recent message as a courtesy  The discussion following the phone number being leaked was simply me telling you that it was illegal and then me attempting to call the number I had written down. There was a delay to your infraction due to several reasons which include: me wanting to get other staff member's opinions on what the punishment should be. You have not presented any evidence pointing out that your infraction is false, this combined with the witness accounts including my own, which by itself is enough. If you do wish to be appealed before the infraction runs out I will allow you to create a new appeal but only if it brings either A. evidence or B. an apology sent to the user who's phone number you leaked and an apology for lying about it.
Thanks,
Zac
